approval.prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset with a clean, readable silhouette and slightly exaggerated proportions. Flat color blocking with minimal fine surface detail, matte hand-painted albedo-only texture, restricted muted palette. No photorealism, no glossy PBR shine, no pixel art. Flat, even, shadowless lighting from all sides on a plain, uniform mid-grey background. Every surface shows its true base color at the same brightness, front and back, with no cast shadows and no highlights. Keep everything exactly as it is except the lower legs and hands: merge each shin into one single solid bone, and join each hand's fingers into one simple mitten shape.
